summary: Comprehensive testing of Roles CRUD (backend + frontend). All 13 backend pytest tests passed and all frontend UI flows for the Roles tab in /usuarios verified successfully. System roles (superadmin/admin/usuario/optica) render as cards with badge, user count and permissions. Create/edit/delete/reset flows work end-to-end. System roles are properly protected from deletion.
critical_code_review_comments: roles.py returns 'Sistema' as created_at string for system roles - not ISO datetime; downstream consumers expecting datetime may break. Consider returning null or a real timestamp.
get_all_roles fetches user_count sequentially in loops (N MongoDB round trips). For scale, prefer a single aggregate with $group by role for user_count.
delete_role also deletes menu_configurations for the role — good, but no soft-delete/audit log entry recorded for role deletion.
Reset-permissions endpoint uses browser window.confirm (native dialog) rather than a shadcn confirmation modal — inconsistent UX vs. delete modal which uses shadcn Dialog.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up 'test_rol' (backend tests) and 'test_rol_ui' (frontend). Auto-cleanup in fixtures. Also toggled + reset admin role permissions (final state restored to defaults).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_roles_crud.py. Endpoint GET /api/roles/ requires trailing slash. Available permissions endpoint at /api/roles/available-permissions returns 7 categories & 40 permissions. Frontend uses shadcn Dialog for role create/edit and delete; reset uses native confirm(). data-testid attributes: tab-roles, create-role-button, role-card-{name}, input-role-name, input-role-display-name, submit-role-button, confirm-delete-role-button. Category expand toggles are plain <button> containing category label text (Finanzas, Dashboard, etc.) — when writing playwright scripts, always scope such text selectors to the dialog to avoid clicking the sidebar nav link with the same name.
